WordPress & WooCommerce Development

Elementor & ACF Builds

Editable page structures that clients can manage without breaking layout, content or design consistency.

Performance & Technical SEO

Cleaner structure, lighter assets and technical improvements that support speed, usability and search visibility.

Custom WordPress Functionality

Practical custom features when plugins add too much overhead, limitation or maintenance risk.

Experience

10+ years of front-end, UX and WordPress experience

My background combines front-end development, UX thinking, SEO and WordPress. That helps me build websites that look professional, work logically and stay manageable after launch.

2016 — 2017

Bergo

Front-End Developer

Bergo was where I learned how a webshop works in practice. Working with developers and designers, I kept Magento pages clear, tidy and easy to use. That job gave me a solid start in building and improving websites.

2017 — 2018

Blueprint Sound Academy

Front-End Developer

Blueprint Sound Academy gave me more room to work on the look and feel of a website. Small changes to layouts, navigation and page details made the site feel more consistent. From there, I started paying more attention to how people move through a website.

2018 — 2019

Kamernet

UX Designer

At Kamernet, the user came first. Simple sketches and test screens helped us see where people got stuck before we built the final version. Their feedback showed me how a few small changes could make the whole journey easier.

2019 — 2020

Easytheorie

WordPress Developer

Easytheorie was where WordPress became part of my everyday work. Clearer pages, better content and work on Google search helped people find the right information faster. WordPress, design and content started to come together for me there.

2020 — 2021

Wube

WordPress Developer

Wube was where I started building complete WordPress websites for clients. Each project had different wishes, so I learned to turn them into a site that looked good and stayed easy to manage. Before launch, I checked phones, different browsers and speed so the site was ready to use.

2021 — Present

Webactueel

Senior WordPress Developer

Today at Webactueel, I work on WordPress and WooCommerce sites from start to finish. Some days I build pages, other days I fix a plugin, speed up a site or solve a client problem. Over time, I have made my own checks and tools so I can spot issues earlier and keep the work reliable.

My workflow

From idea to a fast, maintainable WordPress website

Every project starts with understanding the goal, the users and the content. From there, I turn ideas into clear structure, clean WordPress development and a website that is easy to use, fast to load and simple to maintain.

Think first

I clarify what the website needs to achieve before deciding how it should be structured and built.

Structure clearly

I organize pages, content and user journeys so visitors can find what they need without friction.

Build carefully

I create clean WordPress setups that are fast, manageable and not overloaded with unnecessary plugins.

Improve continuously

I test, refine and adjust details so the final website feels stable, usable and ready to grow.

items.excerpt: Transport booking flow centred on route and fare information, payment options and mobile reservations.

items.title: Miamicarwash
items.content: Miami Carwash uses a direct, mobile-friendly service website to keep the automotive-care offering, brand presentation and contact path easy to understand for customers deciding quickly from a phone before visiting or getting in touch.
items.excerpt: Mobile-first automotive-care site where service scope and visual branding lead quickly to contact.

items.title: Administratiegids
items.content: Local provider comparison is the primary task in Administratiegids: visitors can find services, request multiple quotes and weigh price, reviews and regional relevance. Provider-facing lead information stays on the same platform but separate from the consumer task.
items.excerpt: Local comparison platform built around finding providers, requesting quotes and comparing responses, with separate lead-generation information for participating businesses.

items.title: C10media
items.content: C10 Media's full-service advertising offer had to remain understandable without flattening its channel mix. Media strategy, out-of-home, digital campaigns, radio, television, print and project work were brought into a service-led structure with direct routes to an introductory conversation.
items.excerpt: Media-agency site separating strategy, out-of-home, digital, radio, television and print, with project work used as proof before consultation.

items.title: Blenco
items.content: Blenco turns made-to-measure window decoration into a guided e-commerce journey. Visitors can explore product types such as wooden blinds, roller blinds and Roman blinds, then move from style and colour choices to measurements, mounting preferences and the shopping cart.
items.excerpt: Made-to-measure e-commerce journey where product choice leads into style, colour, measurements, mounting preferences and the cart.

items.title: Prometaal
items.content: Prometaal frames its metal-recycling operation around materials, collection, logistics and responsible recycling in a business-focused WordPress site. The experience supports both companies bringing in recyclable material and organisations that need collection or recycling services explained clearly.
items.excerpt: Industrial recycling site covering materials, collection and sustainability, with business enquiries placed beside the relevant service information.

items.title: Bedrijfsboekhouder
items.content: Bedrijfsboekhouder makes an online accounting proposition understandable for entrepreneurs by connecting bookkeeping, tax returns, annual accounts and optional payroll support with transparent service information, digital-accounting guidance and direct appointment routes.
items.excerpt: Online-accounting site focused on bookkeeping, tax returns, annual accounts and optional payroll support, with digital guidance leading toward appointments.

items.title: Progress
items.content: Shared sector expertise is the bridge between Progress's two audiences. Vacancy pages move candidates toward roles, while employer pages lead to staffing discussions, with reviews and specialist positioning supporting both sides.
items.excerpt: Recruitment site separating candidate vacancy exploration from employer staffing discussions while sharing sector expertise.

items.title: Superfruitmand
items.content: Superfruitmand presents fruit boxes, fruit baskets and gifts through a WooCommerce webshop built around straightforward product discovery and ordering. Product categories, popular products, business information, customer accounts and cart actions are kept visible across the shopping journey.
items.excerpt: Fruit-box and gift webshop where categories, stock and pricing visibility and account access support straightforward product ordering.

items.title: Kroessvisser
items.content: Finance, tax and advisory services lead the business-focused WordPress structure for Kroess & Visser. Services such as bookkeeping, financial administration, payroll, tax support and advisory are connected with trust content, clear service routes and direct paths to an advice conversation.
items.excerpt: Finance and advisory site separating bookkeeping, tax and business services, with trust content supporting the route to an advice conversation.

items.title: Monitorpolitiekeontwikkeling
items.content: Policy positions, research, reports, activities and press updates form the core of Monitor Politieke Ontwikkeling's content-heavy nonprofit platform. Long-form information and downloadable publications sit beside organisational support and contact options in a responsive structure.
items.excerpt: Nonprofit platform built around research, reports, activities and press updates, with downloadable material and supporter or contact options.

items.title: Ibtraject
items.content: Ingenieursbureau Traject uses its project portfolio and public-sector client proof to frame a broad civil-engineering service set. Design, contracts, cost estimates, project supervision, citizen participation and cable-and-pipe coordination are shown alongside relevant project examples and advice options.
items.excerpt: Civil-engineering site where specialist services are supported by project examples, client proof and direct advice options.

items.title: Businesssuites
items.content: Businesssuites organizes flexible office rental around the information tenants compare first: location, workspace type, size, pricing and facilities. Private offices, coworking and meeting options are presented through location-led pages with clear routes to book or enquire.
items.excerpt: Office-rental WordPress website structured around locations, workspace types, pricing, facilities and direct booking routes.

items.title: Gsprivechauffeur
items.content: Trip details, vehicle choice and payment drive the GS Privéchauffeur booking journey. Visitors can choose services such as private chauffeur, airport transport, BOB rides, vehicle transport or valet parking and move through pickup details, destination, vehicle choice and payment in one clear flow.
items.excerpt: Chauffeur-service WordPress website with service-led discovery and a structured booking flow from trip details to payment.

items.title: Connectwerk
items.content: Vacancy browsing and candidate registration form one branch of Connectwerk; employer staffing information forms the other. Sector-focused content supports both branches without mixing their primary actions.
items.excerpt: Connectwerk keeps candidate and employer routes separate while connecting vacancies, registration and staffing information.

items.title: Prolineafbouw
items.content: Latex spraying, system ceilings and walls, metal-stud work, plastering and painting are separated into a service-led WordPress offer for Proline Afbouw. Project examples, reviews and a quotation route give prospective customers practical context before they enquire.
items.excerpt: Finishing-services site with separate pages for latex spraying, ceilings and walls, metal-stud work, plastering and painting, supported by projects, reviews and quote access.

items.title: Ckbouw
items.content: CK Bouw has distinct audiences to serve: project clients, employers and professionals looking for work. Construction and service content and vacancies branch into audience-specific actions while shared brand material keeps the organisation recognisable across both sides.
items.excerpt: Construction and recruitment site separating project capability from vacancies and staffing actions for clients, candidates and employers.

items.title: Mdvinstallaties
items.content: MDV Installaties presents electrical work, renovations, service and maintenance, and locksmith services through a clear WordPress structure. Planned projects and urgent service needs are separated so visitors can identify the right type of support and contact the company without unnecessary steps.
items.excerpt: MDV Installaties brings electrical work, renovations, maintenance and locksmith support into distinct enquiry routes.

items.title: Bluecenter
items.content: Treatment discovery, pricing, practical FAQs and appointment booking are connected across Bluecenter's broad beauty offer. Visitors can move from categories such as facial treatments, PMU, massage or laser hair removal to the information they need before booking.
items.excerpt: Beauty and treatment site that links treatment categories and pricing to practical FAQs and direct appointment booking.

items.title: Byderma
items.content: A WordPress and WooCommerce beauty platform that brings treatments, a large product catalogue, member benefits, booking and shopping into one consistent experience. On smaller screens, the same separation between treatment, shopping and booking remains easy to recognize and use.
items.excerpt: Task separation drives the beauty platform: discovery, appointments and ecommerce remain distinct while visitors can switch between them without losing context.

items.title: Ourwp
items.content: Ourwp presents virtual offices and business-address services in a WordPress journey designed for entrepreneurs. The public website explains KvK registration addresses, post handling, scan services and package options while giving customers direct routes to sign up, contact the team or access their account.
items.excerpt: Virtual-office site explaining KvK registration addresses, post handling, scan services and packages before signup or account access.

items.title: Pastrycompany
items.content: Pastrycompany connects its WooCommerce shop with catering and event-service content on the same site. Product discovery, special offers, ordering, reviews, event services and contact information are structured so visitors can move between buying food online and planning a larger occasion.
items.excerpt: Pastrycompany combines online product ordering with catering services, reviews, location information and enquiry options.

items.title: Casareno
items.content: Casareno's construction and renovation site uses completed projects and a five-step working process to frame services such as renovation, new-build work, bathrooms, floors, doors and finishing. Advice actions follow that context rather than competing with the project evidence.
items.excerpt: Project evidence and the five-step method give prospective renovation clients context before they move into an advice conversation.

items.title: Schipholparkeren
items.content: Schipholparkeren centers the website around the booking journey while keeping parking options and extra services easy to compare. Visitors can enter arrival and return details, choose between options such as valet and comfort parking, and review services including charging, washing and refuelling before reserving.
items.excerpt: Parking-booking flow built around arrival and return dates, parking choices and add-ons such as charging, washing and refuelling.

items.title: Zeninspec
items.content: ZEN Inspection serves international inspection, testing and certification work across laboratory, cargo, marine and other contexts. The site separates those service areas while keeping accreditation, sector expertise and quote access available to technical decision-makers.
items.excerpt: Inspection and certification site with distinct technical service areas, sector context, accreditation proof and direct quote access.

items.title: Astenadvies
items.content: Financial-advice choices are kept concise at Astenadvies so visitors can compare service areas and move toward a conversation.
items.excerpt: Astenadvies separates financial-advice service areas, trust information and the path into an initial advice conversation.

items.title: Koelcellenbouw
items.content: Custom cold rooms, freezer rooms, cleanrooms and turnkey projects define Koelcellenbouw's specialist B2B offer. The WordPress structure explains those technical capabilities for companies evaluating a project, with quote and contact access attached to each service area.
items.excerpt: Custom cold rooms, freezer rooms and related technical projects sit within dedicated service and quotation paths at Koelcellenbouw.

items.title: Doctorcura
items.content: Doctorcura has to keep treatment discovery, product information, medical-process steps and FAQs understandable within the same healthcare platform. The WordPress structure breaks this information into clear next steps that remain readable on desktop and mobile.
items.excerpt: Healthcare WordPress project that separates treatment information, FAQs and medical-process steps into a responsive sequence of next actions.

items.title: Enspect
items.content: Enspect separates SCIOS Scope, NEN, thermography and engineering services before adding practical process detail and trust information. Technical explanations remain readable while quote access stays visible for business customers.
items.excerpt: Technical inspection site separating SCIOS, NEN, thermography and engineering services, supported by process detail, trust content and quote access.

items.title: Leeuwbeveiliging
items.content: Professional security services, business credibility and direct contact lead the Leeuw Beveiliging WordPress site. The experience helps business customers understand the company's security expertise and move toward the relevant service or enquiry.
items.excerpt: Security-services WordPress site combining business credibility with a straightforward enquiry route.

items.title: RBMB
items.content: A WooCommerce webshop for RBMB that turns a broad professional building-material catalogue into a clearer shopping structure across categories, products and next-step actions. The work focuses on product discovery, responsive presentation and keeping purchase or contact routes easy to find.
items.excerpt: Building-material webshop where category hierarchy leads customers from a broad assortment to product detail, purchase or advice.

items.title: Werkenbijefe
items.content: A recruitment-focused WordPress website that brings a large vacancy library, employer positioning, sector information, reviews and application routes into one candidate journey. The site supports both broad vacancy discovery and detailed role pages with clear application actions.
items.excerpt: Werken bij EFE connects vacancy discovery, sector context, employer positioning, reviews and clear application routes.

items.title: Sanatolia
items.content: Cultural WordPress website for Stichting Sanatolia, bringing courses, events, ticket sales and information about art and culture together in one clear online platform.
items.excerpt: A clear and accessible WordPress platform that combines culture, education and events while helping visitors quickly find activities, courses and ways to participate.

items.title: Tenbrugge
items.content: A professional WordPress website for Ten Bruggen that presents financial and accountancy services in a clear, trustworthy and accessible way. The website combines strong structure, responsive design and direct contact options to help visitors quickly find the right expertise.
items.excerpt: For Ten Bruggen, I created a modern and responsive WordPress website focused on clarity, credibility and conversion. Complex financial services were translated into an easy-to-navigate structure with clear service pages, strong calls to action and integrated appointment booking. The result is a professional website that supports both the brand and the customer journey.
